Welcome! Today, we’re about to set off on a journey that’s sparked curiosity for centuries—questions about truth, justice, beauty, and what it really means to live a good life.
Imagine tracing the footsteps of thinkers who shaped the world, as Mortimer J. Adler does in his book, How to Think about the Great Ideas: From the Great Books of Western Civilization. With Adler as our guide, we’ll see how these age-old mysteries aren’t just relics of the past—they’re living ideas that still touch every decision and challenge we face today.
Together, we’ll explore how reason and belief, the search for meaning, and the pursuit of wisdom create a rich tapestry that links us to great minds like Plato, Aristotle, and Aquinas. As we dive into philosophy, ethics, politics, and metaphysics, we’ll uncover how each big idea builds on the last—opening up new ways to understand ourselves, our choices, and the world around us.
This isn’t just about theory or distant history. It’s about engaging with the great ideas as living forces that can shape our character and, ultimately, the future we share.
So, let’s get curious together. Who knows what insights we’ll discover—or how they’ll change the way we see our own lives?
